description: Adapt engine-supervisor.ts for Windows: spawn cove-replay-engine.exe, handle Windows process signals (no SIGTERM — use taskkill or IPC shutdown), manage named pipes or TCP for engine RPC transport instead of Unix domain sockets. Handle UAC elevation detection, Windows Defender interference (add exclusion guidance), and clean process tree teardown on app quit. Existing Linux supervisor logic stays behind platform checks.
title: Windows helper supervisor and lifecycle management
